snippet.title: [Beauties and the Stranded] TEASER
snippet.description:
🎬Finally revealed! [Beauties and the Stranded] Teaser!
Apocalypse, mystery, and even romance!
An unforgettable story with enigmatic beauties awaits…
Coming soon to Steam — don’t forget to add it to your Wishlist! ❤✨


※ Add it to your wishlist now and get notified the moment we launch!
※ Steam link in bio / description!

🖤Game Description
You wake up in a bunker, surrounded by five stunning women.
But something doesn’t add up.
Their beauty feels out of place in this desolate ruin.
Their strength and cryptic clues make you question everything.
Will you capture them, trust them, or love them? The choice is yours!


💗Character Introduction
So-seo (The Bunker’s Chef)
"Welcome back! Do you know how worried I was that you might never wake up?"

Nana (Bunker Scout)
"Last night, you almost broke my back. Don’t tell me you don’t remember?"

Joy (Greenhouse Keeper)
"Show me your carrot... Wow, it's huge. Give it to me."

Ji-ni (Communications Officer)
"...What is he doing? Isn’t he being a little too obvious?"

Da-yeon (Storage Manager)
"I’ll give this just to you. I’ve been saving it."


Each heroine hides her own unique charm and mystery.
Who will you fall in love with? Who will you hunt?

And if you start to suspect everyone, can you survive until reinforcements arrive?

#bats #fmv #VisualNovel #kdrama #interactivestorytime 
Or perhaps, in the process, you’ll uncover your true feelings for them.
